note: eap.evaluate.evaluate_graph requires clean/corrupted pairs of EQUAL token length for positional patching. That pairing is constructible for the synthetic comparison-NLI probe (fixed template, single-token numeric corruption) but not for naturalistic EQUATE premise/hypothesis text of widely varying length -- there is no principled equal-length 'corrupted' counterpart to a naturalistic pair. We therefore do not run evaluate_graph here. Instead we test necessity of Qwen's own NLI-circuit late MLPs (layer_fraction >= 0.6, from results/rq4_circuits.json's qwen_nli.layer_fractions / results/graph_Qwen_Qwen2.5-7B_nli_EAP-IG-inputs.json) on naturalistic EQUATE items via hook-based zero-ablation, compared against a size-matched random control drawn from MLPs with layer_fraction < 0.5 (identical scheme to experiments/rq4_nli.py:necessity_probe_pythia28b).

circuit_transfer.caveat: CAVEAT: the size-matched control pool (layer_fraction < 0.5) includes early MLPs (layers 0-2), which are generically disruptive to ablate irrespective of circuit membership; the control is therefore conservative and the 'necessary but not selective' reading of these numbers is tentative.
